pictures.name: PC1-Locked-Room
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A small upper room in a stone house in Jerusalem at night, a heavy wooden door barred shut. Huddled inside by the light of one clay lamp: a broad-shouldered fisherman in his forties with a grey-flecked beard, in a faded brown tunic, sits with his head in his hands; a younger beardless man with dark curls hugs his knees; two older bearded men in grey cloaks sit close together, listening toward the door; others in the shadows. Single warm gold lamp flame, deep blue darkness. The huddled friends in the middle. Fear, grief, guilt, stillness. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: PC2-He-Stands-Among
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. The same small upper room at night, door still barred. In the middle of the room stands the risen Jesus, a man in a luminous white robe, shoulder-length dark hair, seen only from behind, his face never visible, soft light around him, one hand lifted gently. Around him the friends are rising and stepping back in astonishment: a broad-shouldered fisherman in his forties with a grey-flecked beard, in a faded brown tunic, open-mouthed, the young dark-curled man frozen, the two older bearded men in grey cloaks clutching each other’s arms. Soft white-gold light spreads from him into the deep blue room. Shock turning to wonder. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: PC3-Open-Hands
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. The same upper room. Close view from behind the risen Jesus, a man in a luminous white robe, shoulder-length dark hair, seen only from behind, his face never visible, soft light around him: his two hands held open toward his friends, palms out, gently lit, no wounds shown in detail. Facing him, the friends are overjoyed: a broad-shouldered fisherman in his forties with a grey-flecked beard, in a faded brown tunic, laughing through tears, the young dark-curled man smiling, the two older bearded men in grey cloaks with hands to their mouths. Warm gold and white light on their faces, deep blue shadows. The open hands in the middle. Joy, relief, forgiveness. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: PC4-He-Breathes
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. The same upper room, wider view. the risen Jesus, a man in a luminous white robe, shoulder-length dark hair, seen only from behind, his face never visible, soft light around him, stands in the middle; a soft visible breath of light flows from him over the friends, who stand with eyes closed and faces lifted, calm now, hands open. The barred door is unbarred and slightly open behind them, gold dawn light spilling in. Deep blue shadows, gentle gold. Peace, courage, beginning. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: PC5-Gift-At-Altar
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A first-century courtyard before a stone altar, morning. A man in a rough wool cloak sets his offering, a small woven basket of grain and a clay jar, down on the altar steps and turns away, walking toward the gate, where another man waits with folded arms and a hurt face. Gold morning light, deep blue shadows. The left-behind offering in the middle, the two men either side. Humility, reconciliation, hope. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: PC6-Today-Sign-Of-Peace
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. Inside a modern parish church during Mass, painted in the same sacred oil style: in a wooden pew, a young man in a hoodie turns and shakes hands with an elderly woman in a church hat he has never met; beside them a mother and father kiss, a little boy waves to the row behind, two strangers nod and smile. The altar softly lit in the background. Warm gold light, deep blue shadows. The handshake in the middle. Warm, surprising, kind. No text, no letters, no logos.
